'''Mike Kessling''' (GEMP handle '''Troop1023''')<ref name="cc1" /> finished third on Day 1 of the [[2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix]] and reached its Top 8.<ref name="pc-2025LasVegasGrandPrix" /> A member of [[New Allies]], he has been the Players Committee's '''[[Production Advocate]]''' since May 2024, with forum handle '''Kessling'''.<ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>
